# Energize Music

> Lagos-based Afro-gospel and soul-fusion record label. Tagline: The Energy Different.

## Canonical facts
- Official website: https://energize-music.com
- Legal / brand name: Energize Music (Energize Music Affairs)
- Focus: Afro-gospel, soul fusion, gospel, and related African Christian contemporary music
- Hub: Lagos, Nigeria; audience worldwide
- Primary contact: https://energize-music.com/contact

## What Energize Music is
Energize Music is the record label inside Energize HQ. It develops artists and releases music. It is not a generic streaming playlist brand. Content on this site is the official source for the label roster, catalog and label story. Community, events, Energize Central, Energize Mind and EnergizeFest live on Energize HQ: https://energizehq.netlify.app
